picked.t: Beauty queen spends $700,000 to open Vietnamese noodle restaurant in Canada
picked.body: Their restaurant would serve Vietnam's beloved dishes pho and bun bo Hue , on a busy street in Vancouver. Pho , originating from northern Vietnam, is known for its light flavors, often featuring hints of star anise and cinnamon, while bun bo Hue , from central Vietnam, boasts a spicy broth. The restaurant's signage has been installed, but the couple are waiting for an auspicious date to officially open the business. The restaurant would operate around the clock. Before investing, Huong had studied the local market and understood the challenges facing Canada's restaurant sector. According to Restaurants Canada, about four in 10 food service businesses are either losing money or just breaking even. Industry analysts have warned that restaurant closures this year could outnumber new openings by thousands, with independent and mid-sized establishments particularly vulnerable. In major cities such as Vancouver and Toronto, high rents, labor costs and insurance premiums are putting additional pressure on restaurant operators. Despite the risks, Huong said she was determined to build an independent career, contribute to her family's finances and establish a long-term business in her adopted country. Huong, 36, was crowned Miss World Vietnamese 2010. She also competed in Miss Earth 2010 and reached the top 14.

picked.t: 베트남·칠레, ‘전략적 동반자 관계’ 격상…정치·경제·농업·과학기술 등 6대 협력 축 설정
picked.body: 또 럼 베트남 공산당 서기장(오른쪽)과 호세 안토니오 카스트 칠레 대통령이 정상회담 뒤 공동 기자회견 중인 모습. (사진=TTXVN) 베트남과 칠레가 양국 관계를 전략적 동반자 관계로 격상하기로 합의했다. 또 럼(To Lam) 베트남 공산당 서기장 겸 국가주석은 16일 호세 안토니오 카스트 칠레 대통령과의 정상회담 뒤 공동 기자회견에서 이 같은 양국 관계 격상을 발표했다. 양국은 새로운 협력 관계 내 △정치·외교 △경제·무역 △농업 △과학기술 △교육·문화 △국방·안보를 6대 협력 축으로 삼기로 했다. 공동 기자회견에서 럼 서기장은 “그동안의 양국 협력 성과와 아시아·태평양에 대한 양국의 공동 전략 비전을 바탕으로 관계를 격상하기로 했다”고 설명했다. 양국은 새 관계의 방향과 목표, 원칙, 협력 축을 정했으며, 각자의 지경학적 이점을 살려 동아시아와 중남미 사이의 운송·물류, 자금 흐름, 공급망 연결을 강화하기로 했다. 이를 통해 양국 기업에 더 많은 기회를 만든다는 구상이다. 협력 분야는 무역, 투자, 농업, 전략 광물, 과학기술, 운송·물류·공급망 연결, 금융·은행, 관광, 국방·안보 등으로 넓혔다. 양국은 세무·관세, 과학기술, 국방·안보 등의 협력 협상을 이어가 협력을 넓힐 틀을 마련하고 지역·국제 현안도 논의하기로 했다. 양국 정상은 항행·항공의 자유와 안전을 유지하고 분쟁을 평화적으로 해결하는 데 뜻을 같이하며, 유엔헌장과 1982년 유엔해양법협약을 비롯한 국제법을 존중해야 한다는 입장도 확인했다. 럼 서기장은 이번 관계 격상이 양국이 각자의 잠재력과 강점을 더 잘 살리는 동력과 기반이 될 것이라고 확신을 표명했다. 카스트 대통령은 “협력 관계 격상이 양측의 전략적 비전을 보여준다”며 “양국은 앞으로도 양자 협력 협정 이행을 지속적으로 추진해 나갈 것”이라고 강조했다. 그는 이어 광업 협력을 강화하고 투자를 넓히며 양국 항만 체계를 연결하길 바란다고 말했다. 양국 기업이 산업·기술 분야 협력을 늘리고 시장을 넓혀 양국 경제가 기대에 걸맞게 성장하길 기대한다고도 했다. 앞서 카스트 칠레 대통령 부부는 럼 서기장의 초청에 따라 15~17일 사흘간 일정으로 베트남을 공식 방문한 바 있다. 이번 방문은 카스트 대통령 취임 후 첫 베트남 방문이다. 칠레는 남미에서 가장 먼저 베트남과 수교한 나라 가운데 하나로, 양국은 지난 2007년 5월 포괄적 동반자 관계를 맺었다.

picked.t: 베트남 최대 철강社 호아팟그룹, 재생에너지 회사 설립…자본금 6,500억 동
picked.body: (사진=호아팟그룹) 베트남 최대 철강 업체 호아팟그룹(Hoa Phat Group)이 에너지 분야로 사업 확장을 본격화하고 있다. 동사는 지난 6월 재생에너지 업체의 지분 30%를 인수한 데 이어 최근 재생에너지 전문 회사를 설립하며 시장의 관심을 받고 있다. 호아팟그룹은 최근 성명을 통해 신재생에너지 전문업체 ‘호아팟재생에너지’ 설립을 공식 발표했다. 새 회사의 자본금은 6,500억 동(약 2,540만 달러)으로, 호아팟그룹의 지분율은 99.9%다. 호아팟그룹은 신재생에너지 사업에 대한 구체적인 전략을 발표하지 않았으나, 올 들어 해당 분야에서 눈에 띄는 행보를 보이고 있다. 앞서 호아팟그룹은 지난 6월 6,000억 동(2,340만여 달러)을 투자해 풍력·태양광 발전업체인 쏭허우해상풍력(Song Hau Offshore Wind Power)의 지분 30%를 사들이기도 했다. 베트남 최대 철강사인 호아팟그룹은 주력 사업 외 부동산과 농업,  컨테이너 제조, 가전 등 다양한 분야에서 사업을 벌이고 있으나, 철강이 전체 매출의 95% 이상을 차지할 정도로 높은 비중을 차지하고 있다. 또한 호아팟그룹은 주로 자사 생산공장에 사용할 전력 수급을 위해 전력 사업에도 투자해왔다. 꽝응아이(Quang Ngai) 및 하이즈엉(Hai Duong) 지역에 위치한 호아팟그룹의 철강생산단지 2곳은 올 들어 10월까지 전체 소비전력의 약 90%를 자체 조달해 전기료 약 8조7,980억 동(3억4,320만여 달러)을 절감했다. 지난 1992년 설립된 호아팟그룹은 베트남1위, 세계 30대 철강 기업 중 하나에 올라있다. 올해 1~9월 매출은 누계 170조2,740억 동(66억4,250만여 달러)으로 전년 동기 대비 55% 가까이 늘었는데, 세후이익은 23조7,460억 동(9억2,630만여 달러)으로 전년 대비 2배까지 증가했다.

picked.t: ‘뚱뚱해지는’ 베트남, 당뇨병 환자 급증세…전체 환자 55% 합병증 진행
picked.body: 베트남 내 한 슈퍼마켓에 과자류와 음료 및 주류 제품이 진열돼 있는 모습. 베트남에서 당뇨병 환자가 급증하고 있는 것으로 나타났다. 당뇨병 환자 급증세의 원인으로는 급속한 도시화와 과체중·비만, 신체 활동이 적은 생활습관 등이 꼽혔다. 베트남 수도 하노이 소재 국립내분비병원은 ‘세계 당뇨병의 날(11월 14일)’ 행사를 통해 베트남 국내 당뇨병 환자 현황에 대한 통계 자료를 발표했다. 병원 측의 발표에 따르면, 베트남 국내 당뇨병 환자의 55%는 이미 합병증을 앓고 있으며, 약 60%는 진단조차 받지 못한 상태인 것으로 드러났다. 또한, 30~69세 당뇨병 유병률은 2012년 5.4%에서 2020년 7.3%로, 당뇨병 전단계 비율 역시 13.7%에서 17.8%로 상승했다. 이날 판 황 히엡(Phan Hoang Hiep) 국립내분비병원장은 “이러한 추세는 베트남뿐만 아니라 전 세계적으로 우려스러운 수준”이라며 “특히 국내 환자의 약 60%는 진단을 받지 않았는데, 이는 국제적인 기준에서 매우 높은 수치이며, 성인의 절반은 당뇨병 여부를 확인하는 검사조차 단 한 번도 받지 않았다”고 밝혔다. 그는 이어 “현재 내원 환자는 일 2,000여 명에 이르는데, 대부분이 당뇨병 환자”라며 “하위 의료기관에 상급 병원으로 전원된 환자 중 상당수는 이미 심혈관·안과 질환이나 족부 궤양 등 합병증을 앓고 있는 경우가 많아 치료비 부담과 입원 기간이 길어지고 있다”고 지적했다. 병원 측은 보건부 자료를 인용해 베트남 당뇨병 환자의 55%가 합병증을 겪고 있으며, 심혈관 합병증이 34%, 안과 합병증이 39.5%, 신장 합병증이 24%라고 밝혔다. 또한 베트남 임산부의 23.7%는 임신성 당뇨병을 앓고 있었는데, 특히 도시 지역에서 환자 비율이 29%로 높게 나타났다. 히엡 원장은 “전 세계 20~79세 당뇨병 환자는 5억8,900만 명으로 해당 연령대 인구의 11%, 성인 9명 중 1명이 당뇨병 환자”라며 “이 가운데 절반가량은 병이 있다는 사실을 모른 채 적절한 관리를 받지 못해 합병증 위험에 노출돼 있는 상황”이라고 설명했다. 히엡 원장은 최근 몇 년간 당뇨병 환자가 증가한 배경으로 도시화와 과체중·비만, 좌식 생활습관 등을 꼽았다. 한편, 국제당뇨병연맹(IDF)은 세계 당뇨병 환자가 2050년 8억5,200만 명으로 늘 것으로 예상하며, 성인 환자의 약 80.6%가 중·저소득국에서 나올 것으로 전망했다. 히엡 원장은 당뇨병의 지속적인 증가세를 막기 위해 규칙적인 운동과 체중관리 등 건강한 생활 및 식습관 유지, 정기적 검진을 통한 조기 발견, 합병증 예방을 위한 치료 계획 준수 등의 중요성을 강조했다.

picked.t: Vietnam, China carriers increase flights amid growing two-way tourism
picked.body: Vietravel Airlines launched daily direct flights between Hanoi and Shenzhen on Nov. 14. It follows the launch of its Ho Chi Minh City–Shenzhen service three months earlier. The new route was launched just ahead of the 2026 APEC summit in Shenzhen, with the APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting scheduled for Nov. 18–19, to provide travel options for business travelers, entrepreneurs, and others amid the growing international attention on the city. In 2025, more than two million foreign tourists stayed overnight in Shenzhen, up 70% from a year earlier, according to city government data. So far this year, more than 6.6 million foreign tourists have visited, mostly from countries in the Asia-Pacific. The airline also began ticket sales for new services from Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi to Chongqing, known as China's "Mountain City" and "8D Cyberpunk City," scheduled to begin next month. Located in the country's southwest, Chongqing is famous for its dramatic mountain landscapes, futuristic skyline, river cruises, and spicy Sichuan cuisine. Vietnam Airlines will launch a service between Hanoi and Hangzhou, one of eastern China's major economic, technology, and tourism hubs, on Nov. 22 with four flights per week. Sun PhuQuoc Airways, Vietnam's newest carrier, will begin flights between Hanoi and Shanghai on Nov. 26, one month after inaugurating its Ho Chi Minh City–Shanghai service. Air China started expanding its Beijing-Ho Chi Minh City service from four to seven per week starting Nov. 16, to take the number of its weekly flights to 40. Tourism has become a bright spot between the two countries. Vietnam received 19.5 million international visitors in the first 10 months of 2026, a 13.8% increase from a year earlier. Mainland China remained its largest source market with 4.3 million visitors, according to the General Statistics Office. China received 11.6 million foreign visitors during July-September, a 15.6% rise from a year earlier, as it made travel easier for visitors through further visa exemptions. According to National Immigration Administration figures released on Oct. 20, Vietnam was the third largest inbound market during the quarter behind Russia and South Korea. Dr. Daisy Kanagasapapathy, a lecturer in tourism and hospitality management at RMIT Vietnam, told VnExpress International the government should focus on converting existing travel demand into actual arrivals by increasing peak-season flights from key tourism markets like China. Liu Huiting, commercial director of travel platform GlobalTIX, said Vietnam has attracted growing interest among Chinese tourists since the Covid pandemic. To attract more Chinese tourists, Vietnamese tourism businesses should strengthen promotion on popular Chinese social media platforms such as Douyin, the Chinese version of TikTok, and Xiaohongshu, which play an influential role in inspiring travel, introducing destinations, and shaping holiday choices, particularly among young people, she added as quoted by Vietnam News Agency .

호치민시 껀저와 붕따우 지역 간 해상교 및 해저터널 경로. (조감도=TEDI) 베트남 호치민시 껀저(Can Gio)와 붕따우(Vung Tau) 지역을 잇는 해상교 건축안의 설계공모 당선작이 발표되면서 본 사업에 대한 기대감이 높아지고 있다. 호치민시 인민위원회는 최근 껀저-붕따우 해상교 건축안 설계공모 결과를 승인했다. 심사위원회 채점 결과, 교통운송설계자문총공사(TEDI)가 제출한 출품번호 ‘VB02’가 88.11점을 획득하며 1등으로 당선됐다. 당국에 따르면, 1등으로 당선된 건축안은 설계 개선 과정을 거쳐 이후 사업 단계의 기초로 활용된다. 호치민시 인민위원회는 당선작 출품 업체가 심사위원회의 의견에 따라 최종 설계안을 구체화할 수 있도록 지도하기 위해 심사위원회 및 시 기획건축국과의 협력을 사업시행자인 껀저도시관광(Can Gio Urban Tourism)에 지시했다. 이번 사업은 바다를 가로질러 호치민시 껀저와 붕따우를 잇는 총연장 약 14.1km의 해상교·해저터널 건설을 골자로 한다. 앞서 호치민시 인민의회가 지난 6월 승인한 투자정책에 따르면, 해당 사업은 민관협력사업(PPP) 건설·양도(BT) 방식으로 추진된다. 총사업비는 93조150억 동(약 36억2,860만 달러) 상당으로, 공사기간은 2026년부터 2029년까지다. 사업기간은 7년간으로, 대금은 사업 완료 및 국가 인계 후 3년에 걸쳐 지급될 예정이다. 이번 사업은 호치민시와 붕따우 지역의 연결성 개선을 통해 지역 사회경제적 발전과 해안 도시, 물류, 관광 발전 촉진하고, 호치민시 해안도로와 롱선(Long Son)산업단지 진입로를 연결해 51번 국도의 통행량 분담, 물류·항만 회랑 개발 등을 목표로 한다. 호치민시는 겐라이만(Ghenh Rai灣)을 가로지르는 해상교가 건축적 상징물로 자리매김해 지역 관광객 유치와 홍보에도 도움이 될 것으로 기대하고 있다. 현재 호치민시 껀저와 붕따우 지역을 잇는 육로는 동나이를 우회하는 51번 국도와 호치민시-롱탄-저우저이 고속도로 등에 크게 의존하고 있어, 해상교가 완공되면 이동시간이 대폭 단축됨은 물론, 기존 도로망의 부담이 크게 완화돼 지역 간 연계가 크게 강화될 것으로 기대를 모은다. 호치민시 역시 해상교 완공 시 껀저와 붕따우, 까이멥-티바이(Cai Mep-Thi Vai)항만 클러스터, 롱선 지역이 이어져 해양 관광과 물류·항만서비스·해안경제가 활성화될 것으로 기대하고 있다.

picked.t: What’s next for Vietnam after hitting $1 trillion trade milestone?
picked.body: It exceeded $1.01 trillion as of October, a 32.3% increase year-on-year. The National Statistics Office said the milestone reflected the economy’s openness and deep integration into global markets. The speed of growth is a highlight. It took Vietnam more than a decade to raise trade from $100 billion in 2007 to $500 billion in 2019. But it took only seven more years to double that figure. The statistics office attributed the acceleration to expanded production capacity, investment inflows, manufacturing growth in, and more effective use of free trade agreements (FTAs). Vietnam has joined 19 FTAs, which contributed to the rise in foreign investment. In the year to date, FDI has been a 17-year high of nearly $55 billion, with manufacturing accounting for 51.6%. Electronics, computers, machinery, equipment, spare parts, and phones and phone components accounted for more than half of all exports. Their share could rise further amid a boom in AI investment. There are several indicators that point to further trade growth. In a recent survey of 22 electronics manufacturers, recruitment firm Navigos Search found that 82% planned to expand their workforces over the next 12 months. Their hiring needs ranged from production workers and quality control engineers to research and development specialists. To meet the growing demand for transporting high-value goods such as semiconductors, servers, and AI components, express delivery company Federal Express this month added 567 metric tons of weekly air cargo capacity between the Asia-Pacific and the U.S. The expansion gives shipments from Vietnam an additional route through Clark International Airport in the Philippines besides the Hanoi–Bangkok service. Ee-Hui Tan, Federal Express managing director of operations for Vietnam and Cambodia, said businesses need reliable cargo capacity as they expand in major markets. Surveys also point to a positive trade outlook. S&P Global’s Purchasing Managers’ Index report in October showed that manufacturers in Vietnam were optimistic about output over the next 12 months. Business confidence reached an eight-month high though admittedly below levels seen before the Middle East conflict. HSBC’s newly released Global Trade Survey 2026, which polled 10,000 senior executives in 26 markets, found that businesses in Vietnam and the Philippines were the most optimistic about international trade, with 94% expecting their operations to grow over the next two years compared with 86% globally. In Vietnam, 97% of businesses said measures they had recently taken to address trade uncertainty and disruptions had been effective. Nearly all were using at least one FTA. But challenges remain. Tariffs were the most frequently cited cost factor by Vietnamese businesses, at 52% as against 43% globally. Energy costs ranked second, at 49%, also above the global figure. Some 97% said barriers prevented them from making greater use of FTAs. Andrew Harker, economics director at S&P Global Market Intelligence, said new orders rose in October, but at a slower pace than in September. "While firms are able to maintain improvements for now, they will be hoping for a more conducive environment for growth in the months ahead." Shifting market trends, tougher buyer requirements, and hiring difficulties are also putting pressure on businesses. More than half of the 22 electronics manufacturers surveyed by Navigos Search said they faced high competition in hiring workers. Manufacturing workers are expected to be the hardest to recruit over the next three to five years, 73% of respondents said. They were followed by R&D engineers and specialists (50%) and automation engineers (36%). The bigger question is how much of that trillion-dollar trade Vietnam can retain. The figure measures the total value of goods crossing the border. But since production still relies heavily on imported materials and components, the figure does not capture the value created within Vietnam. At an event held as part of the Autumn Economic Forum (AEF 2026) last month, Mariam J. Sherman, the World Bank’s country director for Vietnam, Cambodia, and Laos, said foreign businesses accounted for 73% of exports. Vietnamese businesses and workers retained little of the value generated by the country’s exports, she added. The statistics office said, as trade grows, Vietnam needs to strengthen domestic production capacity, increase indigenous content, and raise the share of value added by Vietnamese businesses. The next phase should be judged by the quality of trade growth in the form of greater contributions by domestic businesses, products with more advanced technology and higher value added, more self-reliant supply chains, more diverse markets, and growth that better protects the environment. Also at the forum, Fazurin Jamaludin, the International Monetary Fund’s resident representative for Vietnam and Laos, said Vietnam’s total factor productivity has been trending downward recently. picked.t: Vietnam's biggest forex fraud boss 'Mr Pips' gets life in prison for $60M scam
picked.body: The Hanoi People's Court delivered the first-instance verdict for Nam, 32, and 187 co-defendants, after a trial that opened on Oct. 26. Hanoi police said in December 2024 that the group was the largest foreign exchange and securities fraud ring in Vietnam. Nam received life for fraudulent appropriation of property and 12 years for money laundering, for a combined sentence of life imprisonment. Le Khac Ngo, 36, known as Mr Hunter and identified as Nam's right-hand man, received life for fraudulent appropriation of property and 11 years for money laundering, for a combined life sentence. The court also sentenced three members of Nam's "advisory team" for fraudulent appropriation of property: former police officer Pham Truong Son to six years, former lawyer Nguyen Ba Son to seven and former police officer Nguyen Thanh Phong, the older brother of Nam's girlfriend, to nine. Phong received another five years for money laundering, for pooling money with Nam to buy land, bringing his combined sentence to 14 years. Nguyen Hoa Binh, 45, known as Shark Binh from his role as an investor on the TV show Shark Tank Vietnam, received 10 years for money laundering. The owner of the e-wallet Ngan Luong was sentenced for helping Mr Pips evade police scrutiny and launder about VND320 billion in scam money. On civil liability, the judging panel said the defendants should in principle be jointly liable for damages, but that responsibility in this case had to be apportioned. It ordered Nam to pay VND822 billion and Ngo VND510 billion. The other defendants must pay compensation up to the salaries and bonuses they received while working for the ring, about VND297 billion in total. The court ordered real estate, cars, gold, foreign currency, luxury goods and other assets seized from Nam, his girlfriend and his parents to remain seized and frozen to secure enforcement of the judgment and for the second phase of the investigation. As for the employees working under Nam and Ngo, the court said "each person was an important link," with each one's actions paving the way for the next person's crime. They carried out their superiors' will and took part in each stage of the process to trap victims in a spiral of fraud. Before the verdict, the panel received more criminal complaints, bringing the total to 115. As it could not establish whether the senders were victims, it passed them to Hanoi police to verify and urged anyone who considers themselves a victim to contact police. It also recommended speeding up the second phase of the investigation, focusing on the customer care staff and people showing signs of concealing or harboring criminal proceeds, or of laundering money. Prosecutors held Nam, the mastermind, responsible for 920 fraud cases involving more than VND1.568 trillion. To legitimize the money, Nam and his relatives bought dozens of properties, gold, foreign currency, luxury cars and other high-end goods, with the total amount he was accused of laundering put at VND561 billion ($21.6 million). In court, Nam admitted that the securities and forex platforms he ran did not operate like real investment markets. Most investors lacked knowledge and could lose up to 99%, effectively making them gamblers on the platforms. But Nam said he did not pocket all the money, claiming he only worked for a Turkish boss for 4-5% of total profits. He asked the court to consider the criminal liability and compensation obligations of the customer care department he directly managed. In his final statement, Nam apologized to the victims and asked the authorities to quickly process the seized assets to compensate them and return their money. He also asked to be allowed mental health treatment while serving his sentence, and to marry in prison if someone was willing to commit to him. Mental health issue Nam's mental health was raised repeatedly at the trial by his parents and lawyers. His mother described his abnormal behavior as "fluctuating like a sine wave, going up and down between depressive and manic phases." Nam also described these symptoms to the court. But prosecutors said the request for a psychiatric evaluation had no legal or practical basis, as investigation records showed Nam was capable of perceiving and controlling his actions. Clinical examinations reported by Bach Mai Hospital found no abnormalities in six cognitive domains. Nam's girlfriend, Nguyen Thanh Tam, also a defendant, testified that she had kept VND44.8 billion in cash in a wardrobe at their apartment, along with $1.7 million, about 94 kg of gold, watches and dozens of land-use right certificates. She recounted carrying boxes of cash down to the building's lobby and bags of gold back up, and said her boyfriend sometimes did not behave normally. Nam said he could not remember all of his real estate transactions and asked for the seized supercars to be sold soon to avoid depreciation and raise more money for compensation. picked.t: SK, 하노이에 동남아본부 설립 추진…추형욱 사장-베트남 부총리 회담
picked.body: 추형욱 SK 동남아담당 사장(왼쪽)이 16일 팜 지아 뚝 상임부총리와 회담 중인 모습. (사진=베트남정부포털) SK그룹이 동남아 지역 총괄 조직을 신설한 가운데 본부를 베트남 하노이에 두는 방안을 추진 중인 것으로 나타났다. 추형욱 SK 동남아담당 사장은 지난 16일 팜 지아 뚝(Pham Gia Tuc) 상임부총리와의 회담에서 이 같이 밝혔다. 이날 추 사장은 “베트남에 자원을 집중해 사업 모델을 구축한 뒤 인근 시장으로 확장해 나갈 계획으로, 이러한 노력은 베트남의 사회경제적 발전에도 기여할 것”이라며 “현재 SK는 동남아 본부를 하노이에 두는 방안을 계획하고 있다”고 밝혔다. SK이노베이션은 지난 2월 중부 응에안성(Nghe An)에서 진행되는 약 23억 달러 규모의 대형 액화천연가스(LNG) 발전 프로젝트 사업자로 선정, 현재 국영 페트로베트남전력(PV Power)과 함께 꾸인럽(Quynh Lap) LNG 발전소 프로젝트를 추진하고 있다. SK이노베이션은 베트남 내 에너지 산업 클러스터를 조성해 이러한 전력 인프라를 기반으로 인공지능(AI) 및 데이터센터 등의 첨단 산업 투자 유치에 나설 계획이다. 추 사장은 “이러한 클러스터 모델은 기술 프로젝트와 전력 공급 인프라를 연결될 수 있으며, 특히 꾸인럽 LNG 프로젝트는 해당 모델을 적용하는 첫 번째 사례가 될 수 있다”며 데이터 관련 규제를 포함해 신기술 투자 유치 정책의 지속적인 개선을 정부 측에 요청했다. 뚝 부총리는 “베트남은 두 자릿수 경제성장 목표를 위해 2030년 이전에 전력 생산에 나설 수 있는 사업을 우선하고 있으며, 꾸인럽 LNG 프로젝트 또한 SK이노베이션과 파트너사들이 관련 요건을 충족한다면 우선 추진 대상이 될 수 있다”고 화답했다. SK이노베이션이 추진 중인 23억 달러 규모 베트남 꾸인럽 LNG 발전 프로젝트. (사진=SK이노베이션) 베트남 정부에 따르면 응에안성 지방정부는 현재 꾸인럽 LNG 프로젝트 관련 문제를 전담하는 태스크포스(TF)를 꾸린 상태로, 지방정부 차원의 권한을 넘어서는 문제의 경우, 상급 기관과 지속적으로 협의하고 있다. SK 측의 산업·에너지 클러스터 구상에 대해 뚝 부총리는 “정부는 마스터플랜에 동기화돼 투자되는 센터를 지지한다”며 “가스발전소는 중복 투자를 방지하기 위해 가스발전허브와 공동 LNG 저장·항만 터미널에 연계 개발돼야 하며, AI·데이터센터 사업에는 안정적인 전력이 보장돼야 한다”고 했다. 그는 이어 △청정에너지 △AI △데이터센터 투자 확대 등도 기대한다며, 베트남 투자 계획에 대한 마스터플랜을 수립, 구체적인 사업 내용과 시행 일정을 명시해줄 것을 SK 측에 요청했다.

picked.t: Vietnam's top leader To Lam holds talks with Xi Jinping in Shenzhen
picked.body: The talks took place on the occasion of the Vietnamese leader's attendance at the 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders' Week and bilateral engagements in China during Nov. 17 and 20. Both leaders spoke highly of the positive and comprehensive advancement of bilateral ties, highlighted by consolidated political trust and close high-level strategic exchanges. General Secretary and President To Lam asked the two countries to continue elevating strategic trust and raise economic and trade cooperation to a new height marked by greater balance, sustainability, and integration. He urged high priority for strategic transport infrastructure connectivity, particularly the decisive implementation of cross-border railway projects linking Vietnam and China, to serve as a foundation for economic and industrial linkages. The Vietnamese leader called for stronger cooperation in strategic energy infrastructure, especially power grid connectivity. He also suggested making substantive progress in human resources training and requested that China provide additional scholarships for Vietnamese students, particularly in basic sciences and strategic technologies. General Secretary and President Lam proposed the two sides strengthen multilateral coordination and continue exchanges and cooperation in defense, security and diplomacy, helping deepen bilateral ties, make cooperation more substantive and enhance political trust between the two countries. General Secretary and President Xi agreed that the two sides should maintain strategic exchanges at levels, step up exchanges of theories and experience in Party building and national governance, and make better use of existing mechanisms, including the Steering Committee for Bilateral Cooperation and the diplomatic, defense and public security strategic dialogue. He affirmed China's support for connectivity between Vietnam and the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, as well as southwestern China. The two sides should strengthen links between their development strategies and develop synchronised transport infrastructure, particularly railways, expressways and waterways, as well as power connectivity, while also encouraging investment and creating a favorable business environment for enterprises from both countries, he said. The top Chinese leader welcomed increased imports of high-quality Vietnamese products to his country and expressed support for reputable Chinese businesses to participate in Vietnam's industrialization and modernization. China is ready to support Vietnam in strengthening its artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities, particularly in manufacturing and agriculture, and expanding cooperation in green economy development and digital transformation, he affirmed. He also called for greater people-to-people exchanges and effective implementation of the Red Journey programme, adding that China will encourage its young people to visit Vietnam's revolutionary historical sites. The two sides should work together to organize activities under the 2026–2027 China–Vietnam Tourism Cooperation Year, promote collaboration in tourism and education, raise public awareness of the traditional friendship between the two Parties and countries, and expand local-level cooperation. General Secretary and President Xi further called for stronger coordination at multilateral forums, particularly the United Nations, ASEAN–China and Lancang–Mekong cooperation frameworks. The two sides agreed to continue seriously implementing high-level common perceptions on better managing and resolving differences, thus contributing to peace and stability in the region in accordance with the United Nations Charter and international law.
